config.scope: Exploratory retrospective sample of 24 currently listed equities across 12 listing markets; not all-world or survivorship-free evidence
config.selection_policy: Named before outcomes were downloaded; deliberately geographically dispersed, present-day surviving listings. No historical membership, random sampling or complete world coverage is claimed. Download failures and fold exclusions remain visible; no replacement selection based on returns.
config.target: Next declared month-end to month-end log adjusted-close return in each listing's local quotation currency, using a full-month information gap before the decision
config.timing_policy: For target month M, decide at the start of M-1 using inputs ending M-3; enter at the last source daily observation of M-1 and exit at the last of M. Month indices are research coordinates, not verified exchange execution/publication timestamps. No executed-fill claim.
public_source_limitations: Yahoo histories are retrieved today and may contain revisions and retrospective adjustments.
Adjusted-close returns are provider-adjusted return proxies; raw action reconciliation and historical publication timestamps are not certified.
Only present-day named listings are selected; delisted and bankrupt companies are missing.
No FX conversion is performed. Local-currency stock ledgers cannot be combined into an investable global portfolio.
Single optimization seed and five epochs support a bounded exploratory comparison only.
Monthly crisis blocks are short and correlated; bootstrap intervals are exploratory and multiple crisis comparisons are unadjusted.
Protected 2025 onward price observations are excluded. This study does not consume or amend the canonical confirmatory freeze.
